title: Philips 55OLED708/12 (55" 4K OLED, Ambilight, 2023 model), Poland, UI in Ukrainian
notes:
Philips 55OLED708/12 (55" 4K OLED, Ambilight, 2023 model), Poland, UI in Ukrainian
Google TV 12 (API 31), firmware STT2.230831.001 build 20803, board PH1M_WW_9972
ro.product.model=Philips Google TV TA1  ro.product.device=PH1M_WW_9972  ro.product.manufacturer=TPV
Fingerprint: Philips/PH1M_WW_9972/PH1M_WW_9972:12/STT2.230831.001/20803:user/release-keys
MediaTek, 2.8 GB RAM, armeabi-v7a userspace. On Wi-Fi. ro.adb.secure=1.

NOT the same platform as examples/philips-55oled707 or philips-50pus8517 (Android TV 11, board
PH1M_EA_9970A, com.google.android.tvlauncher) nor philips-75pus8505 (Android TV 12, PH9M). This is the
Google TV generation: stock launcher com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx, setupwraith claims Home,
Samba TV ACR is preinstalled, and there is no org.droidtv.usagelogger. The org.droidtv layer is shared
with those files, so their DO NOT DISABLE blocks still apply (xtv, eum, aurora, icp, playtv...).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-55oled708/debloat.txt
(forget and re-join Wi-Fi first, see setupwraith below; then FORCE_SETUPWRAITH=1)
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-55oled708/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (pass it to restore.sh)
Home claimants: launcherx (priority 2), setupwraith .RecoveryActivity (1), tv.settings FallbackHome (-1000)
Live TV app:    org.droidtv.playtv (live_tv_package). HDMI 1-4, component and composite are
com.mediatek.tis (labelled "TIF Test"; keep it), the DVB tuner com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.dvbtuner.
App labels were read from each APK with `aapt dump badging`, not guessed from package names.
Already disabled from the factory, so not listed: tv.wuaki.apptv (Rakuten), ru.ivi.client, the
ATSC and ISDB tuners, com.omni.ssutv.*, and the regional org.droidtv.*config packages.

Applied in small batches on 2026-10-21 with a screenshot and a 30 s idle-log check (50PUS8517 quirk 5
method) after each. No retry loop appeared; the idle log went from 865 to ~690 lines per 30 s.
Home, inputs (HDMI 2 with a PS5), Live TV, Settings, YouTube playback and every remote button were
checked the same day; not yet lived with for days. If something breaks, `pm enable <package>` and report it.
After a reboot `pm list packages -d` was identical: nothing re-enabled itself on this firmware, Play-Fi
and Chromecast included (unlike the 55OLED707 and 50PUS8517). Checked again 8.5 min after boot.

Memory, `dumpsys meminfo` on the home screen; readings straddle a reboot, so approximate:
Stock:                      1,755 MB used PSS (launcherx 182 MB across two processes)
This list + launcher/:      1,582 MB used PSS (com.gathin.tvhome 159 MB)

Quirks on this firmware:
1. org.droidtv.demome asks for TV_INPUT_HARDWARE here, so tools/disable.sh refuses it (#321). Kept.
2. Remote buttons go through org.droidtv.GlobalKey, which hard-codes two of them to the stock launcher:
the gear button (scancode 141, KEY_SETUP) starts launcherx/.dashboard.DashboardActivity and the
Apps button (scancode 779, keycode 813) sends ALL_APPS. With launcherx disabled both do nothing.
Fixed with the launcher's HomeKeyService (HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1): settings_key_scancodes 141 and
app_keys 813:com.gathin.tvhome. Matching the gear button by keycode (327) did NOT work, by
scancode it does; checked with the real remote. SOURCES (768), Netflix (772), YouTube (776), TV
(170, last source) and Quick menu (765) are handled by GlobalKey itself and keep working.
TV Guide (172) does nothing on a set with no channels tuned, before and after.
3. The org.droidtv.candeebug CollectionService is bound by 22 TV processes; none retried after it was
disabled. tv.samba.ssm is bound by org.droidtv.tv.tptvservice:SambaService, also no retries.
4. Settings references io.mimi.tvapp and tpvaudiomanager sends Mimi a broadcast; with both Mimi
packages disabled the sound menus still ope

packages.reason: "GEL" metrics collector, runs inside candeebug's process; disable both
"FrameworkLogger": hands reboot reasons and firmware-install records to the Philips logger
"Samba Services Manager": Samba TV ACR (identifies what is on screen), Firebase + Mixpanel
